android.widget.TextView.text: At one stage the world’s tallest bridge, it’s the incredible height of the Millau Viaduct that gets you. It can get very windy up here because of the eccentric micro-climate of the gorge.

android.widget.TextView.text: German autobahns are a thrill to drive on, with landmarks like the Frankfurter Kreuz showcasing the scale of the network - Joerg Hackemann / Alamy Stock Photo
android.widget.TextView.heading: false

android.widget.TextView.text: Germany is chock full of engineering marvels, such as the Kiel Canal and the Wuppertal Schweberbahn. But pelting along the autobahn remains the stuff of dreams for many drivers, and with the centenary of its inception in Frankfurt taking place this year, there’s never been a more fitting time to do it. The Frankfurter Kreuz is an impressive intersection that ranks among Europe’s busiest and oldest, while in Berlin, the A115 through Grunewald, comprises the former AVUS race track. Without (many) speed limits or any tolls, driving these innovative roads is a great deal more fun than their ruinously pricey Spanish or French counterparts.

android.widget.TextView.text: Where would we be without water? Especially in hot, dry cities like Lisbon. This incredible piece of engineering – currently on UNESCO’s Tentative List for World Heritage status – solved that very problem by bringing fresh water from the mountains around Lisbon down into the city for residents to drink.
android.widget.TextView.heading: false

android.widget.TextView.text: Dating back to the 1700s, this beautiful structure is still standing and you can even walk over some parts of it, marvelling at how it crosses the Alcantara valley at up to 213 feet in height. The aqueduct ends at the spooky-but-spellbinding Mother of Water Reservoir (Mãe d’Água das Amoreiras) in the Amoreiras neighbourhood. Go in and imagine how it’s transformed for special events, like when they project art on the walls. The V rooftop bar at nearby Vintage is perfect for a drink after your walk.

android.widget.TextView.text: The Dutch were so good at dykes that the British invited them over to drain the Fens. Their knowledge of fighting the sea and reclaiming land is a real sight to behold. The Delta Works are worth exploring – huge dams and sluices you can cycle along (watch out for the wind) in the south of the country, protecting against storms and floods.

android.widget.TextView.text: A couple of years ago, I was invited to attend a friend’s July wedding in his wife’s hometown in northern Italy. As the date approached, I remarked to another friend who was also planning to travel from the U.S. for the celebration that I was glad I had just renewed my passport since it was due to expire in May. She responded cheerfully that she was all set because her passport wouldn’t expire until September.
android.widget.TextView.heading: false

android.widget.TextView.text: She was mistaken. My friend was not all set because Italy, as part of the Schengen Area of European countries, requires visitors to have a passport that is valid for at least three months beyond the date they intend to depart.
android.widget.TextView.heading: false

android.view.View.content-desc: Don't Overlook This Potential Passport Issue
android.view.View.heading: false

android.view.View.text: Don't Overlook This Potential Passport Issue
android.view.View.heading: false

android.widget.TextView.text: Fortunately, she was able to expedite her passport renewal and make it to the wedding, but her situation highlighted a fairly common misconception about international travel.
android.widget.TextView.heading: false

android.view.View.text: Having A Current Passport Isn’t Always Enough
android.view.View.heading: true

android.widget.TextView.text: “A lot of us just think we need a valid passport to travel the world beyond our borders, but what many people don’t realize [is] that a current passport alone might not be enough,” said Katy Nastro, a spokesperson for the flight alert service
android.widget.TextView.heading: false

android.widget.TextView.text: Indeed, many countries require your passport to have a certain duration of validity remaining beyond the intended dates of your trip. The most common lengths are three and six months past the date you fly back to the U.S.
android.widget.TextView.heading: false

android.widget.TextView.text: “A lot of countries, namely in Asia and the Middle East, require six months’ validity beyond your travel dates ― meaning if you take a trip to Vietnam in July, for example, your passport needs to be valid up until at least January,” Nastro explained. “If you arrive at the airport and try to get on your flight, some airlines won’t even let you board without this very important bit of time, in which case you run the risk of not being able to take your trip.”
android.widget.TextView.heading: false

android.view.View.content-desc: So THAT'S Why You Can't Smile In Your Passport Photo
android.view.View.heading: false

android.view.View.text: So THAT'S Why You Can't Smile In Your Passport Photo
android.view.View.heading: false

android.widget.TextView.text: Each country has a different timeline for passport validity, so international travelers need to familiarize themselves with these policies before booking a trip.
android.widget.TextView.heading: false

android.widget.TextView.text: “Some may require three months, while others may require six months or even more,” said David Alwadish, the founder and CEO of the passport and visa concierge service
android.widget.TextView.heading: false

android.widget.TextView.text: . “When some countries also require a visa and grant a multiyear paper visa, they may require at least one year or more [of] validity.”
android.widget.TextView.heading: false

android.widget.TextView.text: The specific requirement depends on a variety of factors, including the country’s immigration policies, bilateral agreements and security risk considerations.
android.widget.TextView.heading: false

android.widget.TextView.text: “Therefore, it’s crucial for travelers to thoroughly check the entry requirements of the specific country they plan to visit to ensure compliance with passport validity regulations,” Alwadish emphasized.
android.widget.TextView.heading: false

android.view.View.content-desc: The Items You Should Never Put In An Airplane's Overhead Bin
android.view.View.heading: false

android.view.View.text: The Items You Should Never Put In An Airplane's Overhead Bin
android.view.View.heading: false

android.widget.TextView.text: He and Nastro have both observed a lack of understanding around passport validity rules.
android.widget.TextView.heading: false

android.widget.TextView.text: “It’s common for people to be unaware of the three- or six-month passport validity rule, particularly among those who don’t travel frequently or haven’t encountered it before,” Alwadish said. “The rule may not be consistently enforced across all countries, causing misconceptions among travelers. The complexity of immigration policies, which can change, adds to the challenge of staying informed. Lastly, passport validity requirements may not be well-publicized, leading to lower awareness among travelers.”
android.widget.TextView.heading: false

android.view.View.text: What’s The Reason For These Requirements?
android.view.View.heading: true

android.widget.TextView.text: “These requirements ensure that visitors have a valid passport for the duration of their intended stay, as well as for a buffer period in case of unexpected delays or extensions,” Alwadish explained.
android.widget.TextView.heading: false

android.widget.TextView.text: You might’ve planned a two-week sojourn in the South of France, for instance, but maybe after a few days you realize that you actually want to stay for two months. Or perhaps something happens that’s out of your control.
android.widget.TextView.heading: false

android.view.View.content-desc: The Biggest Mistakes Tourists Make In Italy, According To Locals
android.view.View.heading: false

android.view.View.text: The Biggest Mistakes Tourists Make In Italy, According To Locals
android.view.View.heading: false

android.widget.TextView.text: “This is mainly out of precaution,” Nastro said. “Let’s say you fall seriously ill or have an accident and then need to stay in that country longer than intended. If your passport expires during this unplanned time, it can cause a mountain of issues upon trying to exit the country.”
android.widget.TextView.heading: false

android.widget.TextView.text: The period of passport validity for international tourists provides an extra cushion in case you sustain an injury that precludes you from flying for a while, or you delay your return for other personal reasons. The point is to account for the fact that plans might change.
android.widget.TextView.heading: false

android.widget.TextView.text: “Countries set a minimum of three or six months of passport validity for foreign visitors to facilitate efficient immigration procedures, bolster security measures and improve emergency management,” Alwadish said. “This ensures that visitors have a valid travel document throughout their stay and can respond effectively to unforeseen circumstances. Furthermore, these requirements promote fairness and reciprocity in visa policies, fostering balanced relationships between countries.”
android.widget.TextView.heading: false

android.widget.TextView.text: The specific duration varies from country to country, and not every destination has these requirements.
android.widget.TextView.heading: false

android.view.View.content-desc: Don't Have A Real ID? Here's What Happens If You Try To Fly With Just Your Driver’s License.
android.view.View.heading: false

android.view.View.text: Don't Have A Real ID? Here's What Happens If You Try To Fly With Just Your Driver’s License.
android.view.View.heading: false

android.widget.TextView.text: “For example, the Mexican government only requires that your passport is valid during the entirety of your trip versus after the trip,” Alwadish said.
android.widget.TextView.heading: false

android.view.View.text: How To Make Sure You’re OK To Travel
android.view.View.heading: true

android.widget.TextView.text: “For a lot of folks, it’s not an issue since you get 10 years out of a passport,” Nastro said. “When you realize it’s the year your passport expires, however, you actually might be running against a six-month clock depending on where you are traveling to. It makes sense to just go through the renewal process sooner rather than later.”
android.widget.TextView.heading: false

android.widget.TextView.text: She recommended renewing your passport a year before it’s due to expire so that you know it’s all taken care of early.
android.widget.TextView.heading: false

android.widget.TextView.text: “With expedited processing and wait times at record lows, you’ll most likely see a new book back sooner than expected,” Nastro added.
android.widget.TextView.heading: false

android.widget.TextView.text: When it comes to passports and other important travel documents, advanced planning is the name of the game.
android.widget.TextView.heading: false

android.widget.TextView.text: “While some countries enforce uniform rules for all foreign visitors, others may have different requirements depending on the visitor’s nationality or specific visa agreements,” Alwadish said. “It is so vital that travelers check the entry requirements of their destination country to understand any variations based on nationality.”
android.widget.TextView.heading: false

android.widget.TextView.text: He recommended reviewing an embassy or consulate website in your home country for the place you want to visit. Most provide detailed information about entry requirements for foreign visitors. You might also consult the State Department’s website or travel advisories from the immigration authority at your destination.
android.widget.TextView.heading: false

android.widget.TextView.text: Once you have that information, compare your passport expiration date with your planned travel dates.
android.widget.TextView.heading: false

android.widget.TextView.text: “To cross-reference with the country’s validity rules, start from the day you return and add the number of months required for the validity,” Alwadish said. “The rule is usually three to six months from the day you return, not from the day you leave.”
android.widget.TextView.heading: false

android.widget.TextView.text: Make sure to check the rules of the airline you’re flying as well, especially if you only have four or five months of validity after the date you return home.
android.widget.TextView.heading: false

android.widget.TextView.text: “If you don’t have six months of validity starting from the date you return from the trip, the airline has the power to turn you away, whether they’re right or wrong,” Alwadish said. “You should call them and have them put a note in the system regarding this issue so they’re aware of it prior to your arrival at the airport.”
android.widget.TextView.heading: false

android.widget.TextView.text: Confirm that your passport has sufficient blank pages and is not damaged. If you changed your name recently due to marriage, divorce or another reason, your passport will need to reflect that as well. Don’t forget to see if your destination requires a visa or electronic travel authorization.
android.widget.TextView.heading: false

android.widget.TextView.text: In the event that an issue arises, there are ways to get your
android.widget.TextView.heading: false

android.widget.TextView.text: travel documents in a rush
android.widget.TextView.heading: false

android.widget.TextView.text: , but you can avoid the extra stress and hassle by doing a few extra checks in advance. Then, just relax and enjoy your international vacation.
